rules: The engine MUST bind every inspect or extract result to the SHA-256 of the exact source file.
The engine MUST NOT invent page counts, language or layout fidelity when unavailable.
The engine MUST NOT persist source content or extracted text as operational state.
The engine MUST truncate model-visible text at the policy output limit and report truncated=true.
Docling is optional and manual-only in v1 and is not an automatic extraction route.
